title: Procreate Brush Bundle
author: FinsandFiction
description:
The Painter’s Archive is a complete Procreate brush bundle featuring 100+ creative tools for watercolor painting, digital inking, sketching, texture, blending, and traditional-style digital illustration.
Created for artists who want realistic traditional-media texture inside Procreate, this collection combines five signature artist collections with watercolor brushes, ink brushes, liner brushes, painting brushes, blending tools, wet watercolor effects, grunge textures, stippling, hatching, paper grain, high-resolution watercolor paper textures, and ready-to-use Procreate canvases.
ONE COMPLETE PROCREATE ARTIST TOOLKIT
Inside The Painter’s Archive you’ll find tools for soft watercolor, realistic pigment, wet washes, blooms, bleeds, grunge painting, expressive ink, clean linework, sketching, shading, stippling, hatching, blending, and textured digital painting.
INCLUDED COLLECTIONS
Dead Pretty
A gritty watercolor collection featuring grunge watercolor brushes, splatters, washes, effects, stippling, shading, texture, and paper canvases.
Daydream Studio
21 Procreate brushes designed for soft, expressive watercolor painting, including painters, washes, blending tools, organic pigment, soft texture, and premium paper canvases.
Water Theory
Wet watercolor brushes created to mimic flowing traditional watercolor with washes, blooms, bleeds, organic edges, pigment, blending, and wet effects.
Pigment & Paper
Realistic watercolor painting tools featuring painters, blenders, textures, natural pigment, paper grain, and textured Procreate canvases.
Ink Matter
28 Procreate brushes for sketching, inking, liners, stippling, hatching, shading, texture, and expressive illustration.
The Paper Archive
20 watercolor paper textures including 12 square and 8 portrait papers. Includes high-resolution JPG paper textures and ready-to-use Procreate canvases.
PERFECT FOR
• Procreate artists
• Digital watercolor painting
• Realistic watercolor illustration
• Digital painting
• Ink illustration
• Line art
• Sketching
• Botanical illustration
• Floral artwork
• Food illustration
• Character illustration
• Surface pattern design
• Clip art
• Printable artwork
• Mixed media art
• Stationery design
• Creative business projects
FEATURES
• 100+ creative tools
• Watercolor Procreate brushes
• Ink and liner brushes
• Painting and blending brushes
• Wet watercolor effects
• Watercolor blooms and bleeds
• Grunge and texture effects
• Stippling and hatching tools
• High-resolution paper textures
• Procreate paper canvases
• Traditional-media inspired texture
• Artist-friendly digital painting workflow
COMPATIBILITY
The Procreate brushes and canvas files require Procreate for iPad.
Apple Pencil is recommended for the best pressure-sensitive painting experience.
High-resolution JPG paper textures can also be used in compatible programs that support JPG image files.
DIGITAL PRODUCT
This is an instant digital download. No physical product will be shipped.
The Painter’s Archive was built to give digital artists one versatile library for creating artwork that feels tactile, expressive, and traditionally made.
Paint with depth.
Ink with character.
Build with texture.
One Archive. Endless Ways to Create.
